subject: Signature vendor renewal — pricing & evidence needed
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Signature vendor renewal — pricing & evidence needed

Hi team,

Our DocuSign and Ironclad contracts are up for renewal in Q3 and procurement wants consolidated quotes and compliance evidence by mid-May so we can finalize the 2027 vendor plan. I attached our current license inventory (current_licenses.xlsx) — brief asks below: 

- Marissa: can you run a refreshed RFQ to the short-list (DocuSign, Ironclad, SignifyBox) and collect 12-month & 24-month pricing, and any available committed-discount tiers? Target: baseline pricing + a 2-year committed option.
- Karthik: please list the minimum security/compliance artifacts we need from each vendor (SOC 2 Type II, subprocessor list, DPA, data residency options). If there are any known red flags with these vendors, flag them.
- Laura: legal thumbs-up on contract burn points we should prioritize in the negotiation (data deletion, liability cap, indemnity, export controls).

Timeline: collect quotes + compliance packets by Friday May 13 so procurement can brief finance on May 17.

Thanks — I can take point on vendor coordination for SignifyBox (they asked to email me directly last cycle).

Best,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Procurement Partner, Redwood Inference

Attachment: current_licenses.xlsx

From: Maria Gomez <contracts@signifybox.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signature vendor renewal — pricing & evidence needed

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the note and the inventory. SignifyBox can provide both 12- and 24-month price options; I attached our standard renewal quote (SignifyBox_quote_Q2-2027.pdf). Highlights:

- 12-month: $68,400/year (up to 15k envelopes/month)
- 24-month committed: $62,000/year (1.5% annual CPI cap) + 60-day onboarding credit
- Enterprise support add-on and SLA (99.9% uptime) available at an incremental fee.

Compliance packet: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report, current subprocessor list, DPA (redlined copy on request), and a data residency addendum for US-only storage. I'll attach the SOC 2 and subprocessor list in a separate secure link after I confirm NDA routing.

Quick ask: can you confirm if Redwood requires on-prem or VPC deployment options, or is cloud (US-only) acceptable? That will change pricing for the dedicated option.

On Fri, Apr 29, 2027 at 10:12 AM SignifyBox <contracts@signifybox.com> wrote:
> Attachment: SignifyBox_quote_Q2-2027.pdf

Best regards,
Maria Gomez
Head of Renewals, SignifyBox
contracts@signifybox.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <contracts@signifybox.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signature vendor renewal — pricing & evidence needed

Maria / SignifyBox team —

Thanks for the quick response and the pricing summary. A few items we need to collect before we can advance: 

1) Current SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and scope (which services are in scope).
2) Full subprocessor list with onboarding & termination dates.
3) DPA that includes: data deletion timelines, audit rights, encryption at rest/in transit, and breach notification SLA (48 hrs).
4) Any cross-border transfer mechanisms in place (SCCs, BCRs).
5) Incident history summary for the last 24 months (summary only, sensitive details can be handled via secure channel).
6) For pricing: line items for high-volume overage rates, and any separate fees for API usage/embedding into our platform.

Marissa — please add a column in the RFQ that captures: "compliance packet received?" and "data residency supported?" so we can filter offers.

If SignifyBox can drop the onboarding credit into the 24-month committed option and provide a dedicated onboarding manager, that will help with our prioritization.

Thanks,
Karthik
Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 16:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signature vendor renewal — pricing & evidence needed

All — quick internal update after the first wave of responses. I pulled SignifyBox's quote and started a short-list comparison (vendor_comparison_2027-05-02.csv attached). TL;DR: 

- SignifyBox: most aggressive price at scale if we commit 24 months; includes US-only residency option and SOC 2. Need to confirm subprocessor list & API overage lines.
- DocuSign: expecting their standard renewal packet next week — likely higher baseline but broader enterprise feature set.
- Ironclad: we've scoped them out; they quoted a workflow/CLM bundle that may reduce contract-handling cost but is pricier for e-sign-only volume.

Next steps: 
1) Marissa: please confirm we sent RFQ to renewals@docusign.com and ironclad-sales@ironclad.com this morning. Update the RFQ tracker with SignifyBox pricing & check the vendor_comparison link.
2) Karthik: once SignifyBox uploads SOC 2 and subprocessor list, can you do a quick redline pass on their DPA? If anything material shows up (notably broad subcontractor rights or long data-retention windows), escalate to Laura.
3) Laura: hold for any legal escalations — likely minimal, but we might push on liability cap for the onboarding/implementation services.

Goal: procurement board packet ready by May 13 for finance review.

Thanks — I'll continue to track replies and stitch docs into the shared Drive folder.

-Aditya
Senior Procurement Partner, Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_comparison_2027-05-02.csv
